idea: How to maintain a home water system
title: How to Check Your Home's Water Pressure
description: Excessive water pressure is a leading cause of pinhole leaks, failing appliance hoses, and noisy water hammer. Checking your home's static water pressure once a year is an essential maintenance task. Thread a water pressure gauge onto an exterior hose bib or laundry sink faucet, make sure no fixtures are running inside, and turn the valve on completely. Ideal residential water pressure sits between 40 and 60 PSI. If your reading exceeds 80 PSI, your main Pressure Reducing Valve (PRV) requires adjustment or replacement to protect your pipes and fixtures.
